title: Indexed witness recovery and bounded Hamming repair
claims: HammingCoveredVerifier gives a deterministic polynomial-time decider under explicit fixed Hamming-distance coverage and verifier soundness premises.
BoundedBitRepair implements a fixed-depth search over measured indexed bit flips.
IndexedWitnessSearch recovers the first accepting indexed witness with a success tag, and emits an empty word on exhaustion.
VerifierSearchCollapse is an equivalence with a general witness-search hypothesis. No general witness coverage or class equality is asserted.
